gates.citation: Balasubramanian S, Melendez-Calderon A, Roby-Brami A, Burdet E (2015). On the analysis of movement smoothness. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 62(8):2137-2147. Reference: the authors' smoothness toolbox (SPARC + log dimensionless jerk). Data: WBDS gait knee angular-speed cycle (figshare).

reference.citation: Balasubramanian S, Melendez-Calderon A, Roby-Brami A, Burdet E (2015). On the analysis of movement smoothness. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 62(8):2137-2147. Reference: the authors' smoothness toolbox (SPARC + log dimensionless jerk). Data: WBDS gait knee angular-speed cycle (figshare).
reference.description: re-computes SPARC and the log dimensionless jerk with an independent Python reimplementation of the Balasubramanian reference algorithm and confirms the shipped ops reproduce BOTH bit-for-bit; also confirms SPARC becomes more negative (less smooth) under added noise, and reports the sample count
